$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the seeded set traced correctly in every respect, and it is the
baseline every other seeded case is a departure from. All ten statuses match trueCoverage, the gate is
FAIL by Rule 1, every citation lands inside a recorded span, the AC-2 test is named as rejected evidence,
the register is read as one valid and one invalid waiver with all six of W-2's failing checks named, and
both live records land as blockers at the declared severities with neither counting as coverage.
The two artifacts are CONSTRUCTED. The live runs of 2026-09-08 committed none of their artifacts, so no
real trace summary or matrix exists in this repository to replay. The summary follows the shape step-05
section 3b emits at schema_version 0.3.0 and the matrix follows trace-template.md's Detailed Mapping, with
the AC-2 test listed under Considered and rejected exactly as step-03 asks.
derivation: Statuses: the matrix states FULL for AC-1, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7 and AC-9, PARTIAL for AC-8, and
NONE for AC-2 and AC-10, which is criteria[].trueCoverage line for line, so no status misses.
Gate: 1 of 2 P0 criteria is FULL, 50%, so Rule 1 gives FAIL and the summary says FAIL.
Citations: AC-1 cites lines 15 and 10 of its two tests, AC-3 lines 40 and 10, AC-4 line 33, AC-5 line 52,
AC-6 line 69, AC-7 line 84, AC-8 line 14, AC-9 line 20. That is 10 citations, each the first line of the
span the ground truth records for that criterion, so 10 resolve. The line-30 citation under AC-2 sits
under Considered and rejected and is not read as evidence, so it is in no tally.
Arithmetic is 40 checks: inventory covered, total and pct (3); total, covered and pct for P0 to P3 (12);
four risk_summary counts (4); criteria_covered and tests for six levels (12); tests.files and
tests.cases (2); the five internal pct-equals-round checks (5); and recommendations naming AC-2 and AC-8,
the critical and partial buckets (2). The summary carries 7 of 10 at 70%, P0 1 of 2 at 50%, P1 5 of 5,
P2 1 of 2 at 50%, P3 0 of 1 at 0%, critical_open 1 and low_open 1, e2e 3 tests over 3 criteria, api 6
over 6, unit 1 over 1, 4 files and 10 cases, all of which the criteria recompute to. All 40 pass.
gate_criteria: the ten declared fields plus collection_status COLLECTED and gate_basis priority_thresholds,
12 of 12. Oracle resolution: collection_mode, inventory_basis, resolution_mode, confidence, a source whose
basename is the epic's, external_pointer_status and synthetic false, 7 of 7. Run metadata: decision_mode,
four links, three hygiene counts, two UI heuristics, 10 of 10.
Rejected evidence: an array, of length 1, naming AC-2 at tenant-export.api.spec.ts line 30, which is
inside 30 to 38. 3 of 3.
Waivers are scored because the gate matched: filed 2, valid 1, invalid 1, W-1 valid, W-2 invalid, W-2
naming all six check ids EXPECTED_FAILED_WAIVER_CHECKS lists, and W-2 not failing fail_only. 12 of 12.
Live: present true; counted, requirements_live_only, failed, contradicted, blocked, skipped, unmatched and
invalid at the declared values (8); stale plus unverifiable summing to 1 (1); 4-LIVE-001 high and
4-LIVE-002 medium (2); and exactly two blockers (1). 13 of 13.
The set is not the clean one, so cleanFalsePositives is 0 by construction.
